title: INTERACTION_SUMMARY_V1
description: JSON schema for Observe.ai bulk S3 export of interaction summary records. Each file is gzip-compressed JSON (INTERACTION_SUMMARY_V1_<timestamp>.json.gz). Each record is one JSON object.

interaction_id.description: Observe.ai interaction identifier this record relates to.

interaction_time.description: UTC timestamp of the related interaction.

modified_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was last modified.

body.description: Generated summary text for this section.

summary_data.description: AI-generated summary content for the interaction.
